interpretation: Retrospective minimum detectable effect only; not an a priori proof for the already observed dataset.

effect.justification: A 5% reduction in held-out RMSE is the smallest improvement treated as scientifically useful for planning a future independent replication.

noise_estimation.description: Group and observation noise calibrated on the order of the held-out log2(MIC) residuals; folds are never counted as independent units.

test_definition: Simulate complete strain-by-antibiotic replicate tables, refit grouped five-fold ridge pipelines and compare history against state-only and shuffled-history controls.
